purpose: Select a budget-feasible portfolio of mitigation, protection or preparedness projects across hazards and evaluation scenarios.

mathematical_formulation.decision: x_j in {0,1}; sum_j c_j x_j <= B
mathematical_formulation.equity_constraint: L_g(x) <= tau_g for declared groups g

unlock_rule: Disabled until investment effects, costs, budgets and scenario weights are externally supplied and validated; benefits are never invented from link rankings.

primary_sources.citation: Scaparra and Church (2008), A bilevel mixed-integer program for critical infrastructure protection planning. Computers & Operations Research, 35(6), 1905-1923.
Faturechi and Miller-Hooks (2015), Measuring transportation infrastructure performance in disasters, Journal of Infrastructure Systems.

known_limitations: Investment effects can be highly uncertain.
Portfolio optimisation inherits all limitations of its scenario and performance models.
Solver status, bound, gap and sensitivity to budget and scenario weights are mandatory.
